sloka: प्रदृश्यमानः सर्वत्र हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः ।भेजेऽम्बरं निरालम्बं लम्बपक्ष इवाद्रिराट् ॥५-१-१८१॥
transliteration: pradṛśyamānaḥ sarvatra hanumānmārutātmajaḥ ।bheje'mbaraṁ nirālambaṁ lambapakṣa ivādrirāṭ ॥5-1-181॥

translations.english: Hanuman, son of the Windgod was seen everywhere in the sky. He appeared like a longwinged king of mountains unsupported.
